correctness.rationale: The verifier constructs all 785 nonempty induced-forest faces using two independent cycle tests, all 120 label automorphisms, 23 face orbits and all 15255 regular barycentric flag-orbit cells. All boundary-square identities are exact over the integers. Chain stabilizers fix every face by distinct cardinality, ensuring quotient cell regularity; omissions have unique rank profiles, so each boundary coefficient is unit. The included 7627-pair certificate is replayed from regenerated incidences, each smaller cell having exactly its unique live codimension-one coface and no other remaining higher coface, because a higher chain extension would force two different immediate cofaces distinguished by rank. One zero-cell survives. This proves an actual elementary collapse to a point and therefore integral contractibility and trivial simple homotopy, not just vanishing numerical Betti numbers.

originality.rationale: The checked exact-object classification proves only the nonequivariant wedge of six five-spheres and its rational irreducible S5 homology action, which implies zero positive-degree rational quotient homology but not the integral contractibility or elementary-collapse sequence of the orbit space. The symmetric bipartite-to-forest collapse relates two unquotiented graph complexes and does not assert contractibility after taking orbits. A census of subgroup fixed sets is not a classification of the orbit space. The inspected 2015 foundational publications contain graph-hereditary/devoid definitions and general Morse techniques, not this quotient. Actual semantic research-record and literature searches found no theorem that states or implies the present finite cell collapse. This is priority assessment relative to checked published evidence, not uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: Unindexed historical computational tables or an older equivalent quotient collapse could remain undiscovered.
This is a finite, computer-assisted proof; source reconstruction and free-face checks are included but no external independent mathematical audit has been performed.

value.rationale: For a canonical ten-vertex symmetric graph and its natural cycle-independent vertex-subset complex, the underlying wedge of six five-spheres and irreducible rational symmetry left open the ordinary quotient fundamental group, integral torsion and simple-homotopy type. A complete 7627-pair collapse answers all three at once. This is a structural exact classification for a motivated object, not an arbitrary small subcase or numerical recomputation. General graph-family extensions are not claimed.
